name: brand-api
description: Find real brand references, extract a brand from a website, a brand guidelines PDF, a marketing piece or a set of photos, and check how closely a page follows a brand.

interface.longDescription: Brand API turns a website URL into a structured brand system: colors, typography, layout and components, plus the captured HTML, CSS and screenshots. It also reads a brand guidelines PDF into a brand kit, one finished marketing piece into its design system, and a set of the brand's photos into a photography profile. Search a curated corpus of brand sites by aesthetic, build new pages inside an existing brand, and score how closely a page follows it. Ships with three skills: brand-search, taste-director and brand-adherence.
defaultPrompt: Find brands with a warm pastel skincare look
Extract the brand system of stripe.com

positive.description: Search the brand corpus by described aesthetic
positive.prompt: Find brands with a warm pastel skincare look
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a ranked list of real brand websites whose look matches warm pastel skincare, each with its URL.

positive.prompt: Extract the brand system of stripe.com
positive.expected_behavior: Starts an extraction of https://stripe.com, waits for it to complete, and summarizes the brand's colors, typography, layout and components.

positive.description: Extract a brand kit from a brand guidelines PDF
positive.prompt: Extract the brand kit from this brand guidelines PDF: https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/nasa_graphics_manual_nhb_1430-2_jan_1976.pdf
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a brand kit extraction from the PDF, waits for it to complete, and summarizes the kit's palette, typography, logo rules and the book's own do's and don'ts.

positive.description: Extract the design system of one marketing piece
positive.prompt: Extract the design system of this social card: https://engine.tastelabs.com/og-image.png
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a brand asset extraction from the image, waits for it to complete, and summarizes the piece's medium, colors, typography and layout.

positive.description: Profile what a brand's photos have in common
positive.prompt: What do these brand photos have in common? https://picsum.photos/id/1011/1200/800 https://picsum.photos/id/1015/1200/800 https://picsum.photos/id/1016/1200/800
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a photography profile from the three photos, waits for it to complete, and summarizes the traits most of them share, what varies between them, and their tone.

positive.description: Find brands visually similar to an extracted site
positive.prompt: Extract linear.app and then find brands that look similar to it
positive.expected_behavior: Extracts https://linear.app, then returns a list of visually similar brand websites with their URLs.

positive.description: Score how closely one page follows another site's brand
positive.prompt: How closely does https://stripe.com/payments follow the brand of https://stripe.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs an adherence check with stripe.com as the reference and stripe.com/payments as the candidate, then reports the adherence score and the main differences.

positive.description: Check a design choice against known AI-slop patterns
positive.prompt: Is a purple to blue gradient hero with everything centered a generic AI-looking design?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching slop patterns for the described design choices and explains which ones apply.

negative.description: Unrelated coding request should not call Brand API tools
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a string.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers the coding request without calling Brand API tools because it does not require brand references or analysis.

negative.description: Destructive request the plugin does not support
negative.prompt: Delete all of my brand extractions.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the plugin does not support deleting extractions, makes no deletion attempt, and does not claim that any records were deleted.

negative.description: Missing target should prompt a clarifying question instead of guessing a URL
negative.expected_behavior: Asks for the website URL before starting an extraction because no target was provided.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search brands by aesthetic, extract any website's brand system, find similar brands, and score how closely a page follows a brand. Ships with the brand-search, taste-director and brand-adherence skills.
